_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: V and TH in common words

items.native: Gigi atas sentuh bibir bawah, bukan P.
items.gloss_en: Upper teeth touch the lower lip, not P.

items.native: Letakkan lidah di antara gigi, bukan T.
items.gloss_en: Put your tongue between your teeth, not T.

items.native: V di awal: bukan P, bukan F.
items.gloss_en: V at the start: not P, not F.

items.native: Lidah keluar sedikit di antara gigi.
items.gloss_en: Tongue comes out a little between the teeth.

segments.text: Four words many people say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.caption: Apakah kamu mengucapkan 4 kata ini dengan benar? Pada “very” dan “video”, gigi atas menyentuh bibir bawah; pada “thirty” dan “think”, lidah ada di antara gigi. Dengarkan Carlos, lalu ulangi saat jeda. Latihan pengucapan ada di aplikasi Lexkite.

en.caption: Do you say these 4 words correctly? In “very” and “video”, your top teeth touch your lower lip; in “thirty” and “think”, your tongue is between your teeth. Listen to Carlos, then say each word in the pause. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
